_decision: Row height is a uniform h-8 / 32px at every nesting depth. Origin's own hitTarget = 40px was never adopted; an earlier resolution kept h-9 / 36px, which was then superseded because 36px matched no bidezine convention at any depth. 32px does: it is bidezine's own Sidebar SidebarMenuButton top-level row height, and it is what the DropdownMenuItem / DropdownMenuSubTrigger / ContextMenuSubTrigger / MenubarSubTrigger family renders at EVERY nesting depth — the only bidezine precedent that actually proves uniform height works at arbitrary depth in a shipped component.
_scope: Anchored to the top-level group row 'system-logic' (depth 0). Its pair, F-6, is anchored to that row's own child 'schedules' (depth 1). Read the two together — see F-6.json.

checks._why: font-size is asserted alongside the height because the superseded 36px resolution also carried a different type scale on group rows (text-xs). A height-only check would pass on a row that had silently reverted to reading as a section caption rather than a peer of its sibling leaf rows, which is the actual thing L-9 unified.
